ownReview.scope: Complete translations reviewed paragraph-by-paragraph against current English, including all metadata, practical steps, FAQs and source labels.
checks: Provider mirrors and storage-source-dependent destination retained.
Workplace approval applies to actual data flow.
Selection affects Google synchronization and notification scheduling, without generalizing identical stop/resume behavior to other providers.
Relevant calendars must be restored before judging availability.
Base includes Google/multiple views; Advanced removes ads; Premium adds Microsoft/Teams; permissions remain separate.
Manual busy-time block requires organization permission, privacy review and verification; no automatic masking promise.
ownReview.limits: Own translations and self-review; no independent native-speaker approval, localized UI certification or runtime test.
